results.preview: OKF stands for **Open Knowledge Format** — Archipelago's structured concept schema for teachable technical topics (prerequisites, unlocks, tags).
Every valid OKF concept object must include these 8 keys: `concept_name`, `concept_type`, `difficulty`, `summary`, `prerequisites`, `unlocks`, `related_to`, `tags`.
An OKF `concept_name` must be **≤5 words**, formatted in **Title Case**.
In the OKF schema, the **`unlocks`** array lists downstream topics enabled after mastering the target concept.
Archipelago stores connected learning nodes in **KùzuDB** (embedded graph database).
Queries longer than **500 characters** are rejected by the Stage-1 guardrail with an immediate API error payload: `Query too long` (limit 500 characters).
Query vectorization uses the local embedding model **`Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m-v1.5`** (also referenced as Snowflake/arctic-embed-m-v1.5).
The minimum cosine similarity threshold before KùzuDB retrieval is **0.75**...

results.preview: When text has no teachable technical concept, the OKF extraction engine must return an empty JSON array: **`[]`**.
High-speed synthesis in the two-pass inference pipeline uses **Gemini** (configured primary: `gemini-2.5-flash` / flash-lite failover chain via `GEMINI_MODEL` / `ARCHIPELAGO_GEMINI_MODEL`).
Institutional catalog integration introduced three node types: **`Subject`**, **`Resource`**, and **`JournalIssue`**.
A **`HAS_ISSUE`** edge connects a `JournalIssue` node to its parent paper/journal `Resource` node.
The `Document` node schema stores external PDF assets via **`pdf_url STRING`** without loading full binaries into server memory.
A concept must **never** appear in its own `prerequisites` or `unlocks` arrays — this rule prevents circular graph dependencies on individual nodes.
